text.name: Decidueye

attacks.name: Stock Up on Feathers
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Power Shot
attacks.text: Discard a Basic {Grass} Energy card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

text.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Combustion Chain
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

text.name: Palafin

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Justice Kick
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Random Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

text.name: Mimikyu

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

text.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Avenging Knuckle
attacks.text: If any of your {Fighting} Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Accelerating Stab
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.

text.flavor: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

text.name: Hawlucha

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Flying Entry
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.

text.flavor: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

text.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Rout
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dread Mountain
attacks.text: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

text.flavor: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

text.name: Absol

attacks.name: Darkfall
attacks.text: If you have at least 3 {Darkness} Energy in play, this attack does 50 more damage.

text.flavor: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

text.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Foul Play
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

text.flavor: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

text.name: Metagross

attacks.name: Meteor Mash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Meteor Mash attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Luster Blast
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

text.name: Jirachi

attacks.name: Swelling Wish
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

text.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Colorful Catch
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

text.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: But First, Food
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon. If you do, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

text.name: Wooloo

attacks.name: Knock Over
attacks.text: You may discard a Stadium in play.

text.flavor: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
